description: Haltestellen im Kreis Herzogtum Lauenburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset includes the stops in the district of Herzogtum Lauenburg. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Stations in the district of Duchy of Lauenburg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Haltestellen, ÖPNV. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
